title: When Your Teen’s Friend Is Always in Crisis
summary: Help a caring teenager distinguish ordinary support from dangerous secrets, bring capable adults into serious risk, and set humane limits without taking over the friendship.
seo_title: When a Teen’s Friend Is Always in Crisis
seo_description: Help your teen care for a friend in crisis without becoming the only responder. Learn when to involve adults, set boundaries, and use practical scripts.
release_move: After safety responsibility is shared with capable help, let the teenager choose and deliver an age-appropriate boundary, ordinary reply timing, and how to continue the friendship.

core_belief_shift.from: Protecting my teen means judging the friend or taking control of the friendship before the situation swallows them.
core_belief_shift.to: I can protect safety and functioning while helping my teen care humanely, widen support, hold a boundary, and retain ordinary friendship ownership.

book_relevance.reason: The Social Playbook is a soft teen-facing fit for empathy, boundaries, relationship roles, and dignified language; it is optional practice, not crisis guidance or a substitute for capable help.

hero.alt: A concerned mother sits in the hallway while her tired teenage daughter looks at a phone from the edge of her bed late at night.

social_image.alt: A concerned mother sits in the hallway while her tired teenage daughter looks at a phone from the edge of her bed late at night.
